extraction.Name: Peter Condelario
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 320 acre allotment, on account of not wishing to pay the taxes; but that he was advised by the Indian Agency that it was necessary for him to accept it, and he did so
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged the place to The State Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $1600.00; that he was unable to keep up the payments on this mortgage, and, in 1924, the bank foreclosed
extraction.Buyer: The State Bank of Interior, South Dakota (foreclosed in 1924)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: taxes got behind from 1919 until 1923, when he mortgaged the place to The State Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $1600.00; that he was unable to keep up the payments on this mortgage, and, in 1924, the bank foreclosed
extraction.Occupation/Income: income is derived entirely from following the carpentry trade
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, health not very good; has a wife and five minor children to support; wife's health is very poor, and has been for ten years; children all have good health; has never received any help from the County or the Government; allotment was 320 acres; document number 1755; sworn November 19, 1928, Shannon County, South Dakota
